newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Cohen in Kuwait to discuss Gulf security.
newsitem.headline: Cohen in Kuwait to discuss Gulf security.

text.p: U.S. Defence Secretary William Cohen arrived in Kuwait on Sunday on the second leg of a tour of Gulf Arab states where he is expected to discuss the security of the oil-rich region, diplomats said.
"The security of the region would be an important item on his (Cohen's) agenda," a senior diplomat said.
Cohen, who arrived from neighbouring Saudi Arabia, is expected to meet Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah and senior officials during his visit.
Cohen's tour will also take him to Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates and Oman before flying home on Wednesday.

Since the 1991 U.S.-led Gulf War which ended a seven-month Iraqi occupation of Kuwait, Washington maintained a major naval fleet in the Gulf and has nearly 200 attack jets in the region, keeping watch over southern Iraq.
U.S. ground troops maintain an almost around the year presence in Kuwait where Washington stores pre-positioned military equipment including tanks and armoured vehicles.
